title: The average person here spends $49,000 a year. Top 5 biggest spenders
description: Where does the average person spend the most money in a year? Number one will surprise you. Real World Bank data (household spending per person, 2024, in constant 2015 US dollars), counted down from five to one.
source: World Bank, household final consumption expenditure per capita (constant 2015 US$, 2024, 159 countries with 2024 data), data.worldbank.org/indicator/NE.CON.PRVT.PC.KD

segments.text: The average person here spends forty-nine thousand dollars a year. Can you guess where?

props.kicker: Spent per person, in one year

segments.text: Top five. Number five is Luxembourg. Thirty-eight thousand dollars.
Number four is Norway. Thirty-nine thousand.
Number three is Switzerland. Almost forty-six thousand.
Number two beats the Swiss. The United States. Forty-six thousand dollars.
And number one is Bermuda. Over forty-nine thousand. Almost everything on the island is shipped in, so daily life costs a fortune.
In America, spending per person grew forty-six percent since 2000. Even after inflation.
In Burundi, people spend just one hundred ninety-five dollars a year. Bermuda spends two hundred fifty-four times more.
